card.tag: A dub mixing desk you play live
card.what: In dub, the mixing desk is the instrument. Dubwise FM is an eight-channel reggae band (FM drums, bass, skank, organ, melodica or horns, sirens and shouts), each channel with a mute and a throw, feeding a tape echo you can push into feedback and a spring reverb you can kick. Quantised mutes land on the one with a countdown, the stepped Big Knob filter clicks like King Tubby's, and every drop, throw and sweep is yours: nothing plays itself. Record your moves into a song, recall them as scenes, or take the eight stems out over USB.
